# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_loa_update (Action)

Replaces the signed Letter of Authorization document of an enterprise's reputation monitoring; Telnyx reviews it again.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the new signed LOA document (from the Telnyx Documents API). Changing it resets LOA approval; the new document must be approved before more numbers can be added.
